basics.description: **Azure Monitor Lab** — full portal deployment. Every setting is provided here in the UI; no local config file is required. Pick a **Resource group** and **Region**, then step through the tabs to tune workloads, monitoring, and advanced options. Sensible defaults are pre-filled everywhere.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Azure region for all lab resources. northeurope is the recommended default. (The Health Model preview and AI stage pin to swedencentral, and the App Service pins to westeurope, automatically — regardless of this choice.)

basics.name: namePrefix
basics.label: Name prefix
basics.toolTip: Short prefix used to build resource names. Lowercase, 3-8 chars.

basics.name: alertEmail
basics.label: Alert email
basics.toolTip: Email address that receives Action Group notifications.

basics.name: vmAdminUsername
basics.label: VM admin username
basics.toolTip: Admin username for the demo VMs.

constraints.validationMessage: Lowercase, start with a letter, 3-32 chars.

toolTip.password: Admin password for the demo VMs. Must meet Azure complexity rules.

elements.name: deployLinuxVm
elements.label: Deploy Linux VM
elements.toolTip: Deploy the Ubuntu 22.04 demo VM (VM Insights).

elements.name: deployWindowsVm
elements.label: Deploy Windows VM
elements.toolTip: Deploy the Windows Server 2022 demo VM (VM Insights).

elements.name: vmSize
elements.label: VM size
elements.toolTip: VM size for the demo VMs (kept small for a lab).

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid VM SKU, e.g. Standard_B2s.
Enter a valid VM SKU, e.g. Standard_B2s.

elements.name: aksNodeCount
elements.label: AKS node count
elements.toolTip: Number of nodes in the AKS node pool.

elements.name: dailyCapGb
elements.label: Daily ingestion cap (GB)
elements.toolTip: Daily ingestion cap on the central Log Analytics workspace.

elements.name: enableSentinel
elements.label: Enable Microsoft Sentinel
elements.toolTip: Enable Microsoft Sentinel on the central workspace.

elements.name: enablePlatformLogsDcr
elements.label: Enable platform-logs DCR (preview)
elements.toolTip: Scenario 51 (public preview). Collects Azure Managed Grafana platform logs in the central workspace and requires a supported region.

elements.name: enableMetricsExportDcr
elements.label: Enable metrics-export DCR
elements.toolTip: Scenario 52 (GA). The DCR and central workspace must be in the same region.

elements.name: enableLawReplication
elements.label: Enable LAW cross-region replication
elements.toolTip: Doubles ingestion cost. Requires a paired secondary region below.

elements.name: lawReplicationLocation
elements.label: LAW replication region
elements.toolTip: Secondary region (must be a paired region of the primary). Required when replication is enabled.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a region short name, e.g. westeurope.

options.text: The secondary region must be in the supported list for Log Analytics workspace replication.

elements.name: grafanaAdminObjectId
elements.label: Grafana administrator object ID (optional)
elements.toolTip: Leave empty to grant your deployment identity Grafana Admin. For automation or a different lab operator, enter the Microsoft Entra user or group object ID, not an application client ID.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a nonzero Microsoft Entra user or group object ID in GUID format, or leave empty.

elements.name: ownerTag
elements.label: Owner tag
elements.toolTip: Value for the 'owner' tag applied to every resource.

elements.name: appServiceRepoUrl
elements.label: App Service sample repo URL
elements.toolTip: Public GitHub repo deployed to the App Service.

elements.name: siemWebhookUrl
elements.label: SIEM / Teams webhook URL (optional)
elements.toolTip: Optional secondary SIEM/Teams webhook added to the Action Group. Leave empty to skip.

elements.name: enableAi
elements.label: Enable optional AI stage
elements.toolTip: Deploys Microsoft Foundry, four billable model deployments, AI monitoring, alerts, and an AI FinOps workbook in swedencentral. Off by default.

options.text: The AI stage deploys billable Microsoft Foundry models in swedencentral. The portal deployment creates the infrastructure only. After deployment, run ./scripts/setup-ai.ps1 -ResourceGroup <resource-group> to create the agents and generate simulated traffic.

elements.name: enableSreAgent
elements.label: Enable optional SRE Agent stage
elements.toolTip: Deploys the preview Azure SRE Agent and connectors in swedencentral. Active usage is billable and always-on billing can begin after an eligible trial. Requires subscription-level role-assignment permission.

options.text: Azure SRE Agent uses a preview API, is pinned to swedencentral, and creates a subscription-scope Monitoring Contributor assignment for its connector identity. After deployment, run ./scripts/setup-sre-agent.ps1 -SubscriptionId <subscription-id> -ResourceGroup <resource-group> to validate the agent and print its portal URL. Delete the agent before the trial ends if you do not intend to continue with paid usage. Custom investigators and response plans are configured after deployment.
